art_note: The imagery relies on composited lifestyle shots and generic marketplace-style size charts, failing to meet luxury e-commerce standards.
desc_en: A refined silhouette redefining everyday elegance. This sleeveless midi dress features a graceful V-shaped neckline that delicately frames feminine lines. Crafted from textured polyester for absolute comfort. The elastic waistband subtly defines natural proportions and silhouette. Functional front pockets introduce modern utility to the design. A versatile piece tailored for distinguished occasions. Made to order. Worldwide shipping.
desc_es: Una silueta refinada que redefine la elegancia cotidiana. Este vestido midi sin mangas presenta un pronunciado escote en V que enmarca delicadamente las líneas femeninas. Confeccionado en poliéster texturizado para una comodidad absoluta. La cintura elástica define con sutileza la proporciones naturales de la silueta. Incorpora bolsillos frontales funcionales que aportan modernidad al diseño. Una pieza versátil pensada para ocasiones distinguidas. Made to order. Worldwide shipping.
